PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. You posted this in #central-team on June 9.

The mismatch was in the door labels. The import file calls the doors E1 and E2, but Marrow's booking sheet calls them 01 and 02. You wanted that settled before anyone reimported the file, because a reimport could create duplicate doors.

I only have the channel thread to go on. I can't see the ticket itself, so I don't know whether the mismatch was resolved.
